tail:
Receipt written to `research/frontier-17-tau.json`. Two findings repaired, eight blocked.

**Repaired**
- `items/lem-transitive-subgroups-of-s-four-and-the-resolvent-action.md:34` — `$|H\cap V_4|$` → `$\lvert H\cap V_4\rvert$`. The two bare pipes were splitting the header into six cells against a four-cell delimiter row, so remark-gfm rejected the table and emitted raw pipes. Now emits one `<table>`, 4 `<th>`, 20 `<td>`.
- `items/fs-spherical-coordinates-are-globally-injective.md:80` — the inline 3×3 Jacobian moved to a `$$` display block after the step (corpus pattern, cf. `cor-multivariable-taylor-formula-with-peano-remainder.md`), step number and `[step 1.3, L1, L5, algebra]` tag unchanged. Renders whole inside its delimiters.

Repo-wide gates pass: precheck 4924/0, depcheck, fwdcheck, extcheck, rendercheck, prosecheck, depsource. The Tau guard reports no scope, content-loss, frontmatter, heading, step or untracked-file problems — its only eight lines are the blocked rows.

**Blocked (S-002…S-009)** — and I did not take Sigma's renderer-side diagnosis on trust. I rendered the exact TeX for S-002/003/004/005/006 with the app's own KaTeX 0.18.1 and `katex.min.css` in the same headless Edge build that produced the captures: every construct renders correctly. So there is no source defect in those files.

Two things that go beyond Sigma's receipt:

1. **It is not a capture artefact.** S-004 and S-005 reproduce on the live site — `alphabetamath.cc/real-analysis/line-integrals-and-the-gradient-theorem-examples` renders `\|q-p\|_2` as `‖q − p‖2` and `\ne` as a detached `/=`, on already-published legacy content. Readers are seeing this now.
2. **It is new, and it is app-side.** frontier-16's Sigma approved 22 captures on 2026-08-21 at app HEAD `f7613cb` with zero findings; frontier-17 captured 2026-08-23 at `4882f89`. The only dependency movement between them is `next` 16.2.9 → 16.2.12 (katex unchanged at 0.18.1). The symptom set — collapsed `\frac` vlists, detached `\not` overlay, baseline-height subscripts, overlapping `_2^2`, unstyled tables, inline math wrapping mid-atom — is what happens when `katex.min.css` (imported in `web/app/library/layout.tsx`) loses the cascade to Tailwind on the library route.

That fix is in the app repo and outside Tau's authority, so Step 10 stops here as designed. `research/frontier-17-tau-rejudge-targets.json` was not written (the guard exits 1 on any blocked row), so the two repaired items still owe their paired rejudge whenever the run resumes.
